deadline_note: Bachelor of Science, 2027 intake: Round 1 closed 20 Oct 2026; Round 2 runs 21 Oct 2026 – 6 Jan 2027 (23:59 CET); Round 3 runs 7 Jan – 8 Feb 2027 (14:00 CET). Aid is limited, so apply early if you need it.

tuition_intl.note: Bachelor of Science 2027 intake: €19,600/yr non-EU, €15,900/yr EU/EEA; €105 application fee; on-campus housing about €606/month.

aid_intl.en: Merit-based and need-based scholarships from the École Polytechnique Foundation (the two can be combined); aid is limited and usually does not cover full tuition.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT required (scores can be reported if taken). English: TOEFL iBT 90 or IELTS 6.5 (min 6 per skill) or Cambridge C1/C2 176; results under two years old. No French required to apply (B2 French needed to graduate). Shortlisted candidates have a ~50-minute online interview.

summary.en: The undergraduate gateway to Institut Polytechnique de Paris, ranked 41st in the world by QS 2026, is École Polytechnique’s English-taught Bachelor of Science. It is a selective three-year double-major programme in mathematics and science on the Paris-Saclay campus.
summary.ka: პარიზის პოლიტექნიკური ინსტიტუტის (QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 41-ე) საბაკალავრო კარიბჭეა École Polytechnique-ის ინგლისურენოვანი Bachelor of Science. ეს არის შერჩევითი სამწლიანი ორმაგი სპეციალობის პროგრამა მათემატიკასა და მეცნიერებებში, პარიზ-საკლეს კამპუსზე.
summary.ar: بوابة البكالوريوس في معهد باريس للبوليتكنيك، المصنّف 41 عالمياً في QS 2026، هي برنامج Bachelor of Science في إيكول بوليتكنيك الذي يُدرَّس بالإنجليزية. وهو برنامج انتقائي مدته ثلاث سنوات بتخصص مزدوج في الرياضيات والعلوم في حرم باريس-ساكلاي.

about.en:
Institut Polytechnique de Paris groups France’s leading engineering schools (École Polytechnique, ENSTA, ENSAE, Télécom Paris, Télécom SudParis). For undergraduates, the main English-taught entry is École Polytechnique’s Bachelor of Science: three years, fully in English, with double majors such as Mathematics & Computer Science, Mathematics & Economics and Mathematics & Physics, plus a BS/MS track with Columbia University and a Global Dual Degree in Engineering. Students live on the Palaiseau campus south of Paris.

Admission is holistic but demands very strong maths and science: you apply online with transcripts, a personal statement and two referees, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed online. There are three application rounds for 2027 entry, and financial aid (merit and need-based) is limited, so apply in an early round if you need support.

platform: Études en France / DAP (non-EU); Parcoursup (EU and French/European bac holders)
deadline_note: First-year Licence (L1) for non-EU applicants: Études en France / DAP files must be submitted by 15 Dec 2026 at the latest (some Campus France offices close earlier). EU applicants and holders of a French/European bac apply on Parcoursup (Jan–Mar 2027).

tuition_intl.note: 2025/26 national Licence fee; non-EU students subject to differentiated fees receive a partial exemption that brings them to the domestic rate (Board resolution CA-2026-013). 2026/27 rates pending.

aid_intl.en: Very low tuition for everyone thanks to the fee exemption; individual fee waivers on social criteria. Few undergraduate scholarships for internationals.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Most undergraduate degrees are taught in French: B2–C1 French required (DAP: TCF or DELF/DALF B2, or TEF 400/699). No English test needed for French-taught Licences.

summary.en: A research powerhouse south of Paris, ranked 70th in the world by QS 2026 and especially strong in mathematics and physics. Undergraduate degrees are mostly in French and cost the same low fee for international students.
summary.ka: კვლევითი გიგანტი პარიზის სამხრეთით, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 70-ე, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი მათემატიკასა და ფიზიკაში. საბაკალავრო პროგრამები ძირითადად ფრანგულ ენაზეა, და უცხოელებიც იგივე დაბალ საფასურს იხდიან.
summary.ar: قوة بحثية جنوب باريس، تحتل المرتبة 70 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز خصوصاً في الرياضيات والفيزياء. برامج البكالوريوس غالباً بالفرنسية، ويدفع الطلاب الدوليون الرسوم المنخفضة نفسها.

about.en:
Université Paris-Saclay brings together former Université Paris-Sud, several grandes écoles and national research labs on a large science campus south-west of Paris. It is known worldwide for mathematics (multiple Fields medallists) and physics, and offers Licence (bachelor) degrees across sciences, law, economics, sport and health.

First-year Licence courses are taught in French, so plan for B2–C1 French. Non-EU students who do not hold a French or European baccalaureate apply through Études en France (or a DAP file if their country is not covered) by mid-December; EU students use Parcoursup. Thanks to a partial exemption, non-EU students pay the same low national fee as French students.

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK. Medicine and dentistry closed 15 Oct 2026. International applicants may still apply until 30 Jun 2027 if places remain.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by course and are confirmed in the offer letter; the first-year fee stays fixed for the whole course. UK fee for 2027 entry is £10,050.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for internationals, e.g. High Fliers Undergraduate Scholarships (£5,000 off first-year tuition for students from selected countries); over £7.5m in international scholarships. US students can use Federal Direct Loans.

tests.en: SAT/ACT used only for US-curriculum applicants (e.g. HSD with GPA 3.2+ plus APs/SAT/ACT; ACT 28 or SAT 670 can satisfy maths/English). English: typically IELTS 6.0–6.5 (no band below 5.5–6.0) depending on course; e.g. Philosophy BA needs IELTS 6.5 (6.0 per band) or TOEFL iBT 88 (pre-2026 scale) / 4.5 (new scale).

summary.en: A Russell Group campus university in England’s second city, ranked 76th in the world by QS 2026. It offers a broad range of degrees with a traditional red-brick campus and strong graduate employability.
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის კამპუსური უნივერსიტეტი ინგლისის მეორე ქალაქში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 76-ე. გთავაზობს ფართო არჩევანის პროგრამებს ტრადიციულ კამპუსზე და კურსდამთავრებულთა მაღალ დასაქმებას.
summary.ar: جامعة حرمية من مجموعة راسل في ثاني أكبر مدينة في إنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 76 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم مجموعة واسعة من البرامج في حرم تقليدي مع فرص توظيف قوية للخريجين.

about.en:
The University of Birmingham is a founding member of the Russell Group with a large green campus at Edgbaston and undergraduate programmes across arts, social sciences, law, business, engineering, life sciences and medicine. It also runs a Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences degree for students who want breadth.

Applications go through UCAS. Offers are set per course; for example Philosophy asks AAB or IB 32 with 6,6,5 at Higher Level. Applicants with a US high school diploma generally need a 3.2+ GPA plus APs, SAT or ACT. International fees vary by course and are fixed for the duration of study.

gpa_note.en: Course-specific offers, e.g. Philosophy BA: AAB at A-level or IB 32 with 6,6,5 at HL; US HSD: unweighted GPA 3.2+ plus APs, SAT or ACT.

deadline_note: Round 1 for autumn 2027 opened 16 Oct 2026; apply by 15 Jan 2027, upload documents and pay the fee by 1 Feb 2027; results 8 Apr 2027. Non-EU applicants must use Round 1.

tuition_intl.note: Whole-programme fee for the English-taught BSc in Information and Communication Technology is SEK 453,000 (3 years) for non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens; EU/EEA free. Application fee SEK 900.

aid_intl.en: KTH offers no scholarships for its bachelor’s programme. Non-EU students may look at external funding only; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master’s level.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. English 6 equivalent: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 20). The programme also requires upper-secondary mathematics at an advanced level. Most other KTH bachelor’s degrees are taught in Swedish.

summary.en: Sweden’s largest technical university, ranked 78th in the world by QS 2026. Its only English-taught bachelor’s is a three-year BSc in Information and Communication Technology in Stockholm.
summary.ka: შვედეთის უდიდესი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 78-ე. ერთადერთი ინგლისურენოვანი საბაკალავრო პროგრამაა სამწლიანი BSc ინფორმაციულ და საკომუნიკაციო ტექნოლოგიებში, სტოკჰოლმში.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة تقنية في السويد، تحتل المرتبة 78 عالمياً في QS 2026. برنامج البكالوريوس الوحيد بالإنجليزية هو بكالوريوس علوم ثلاثي السنوات في تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات في ستوكهولم.

about.en:
KTH is Sweden’s leading engineering school, with research and teaching across computer science, electrical and mechanical engineering, architecture and industrial management. Most undergraduate engineering degrees are taught in Swedish; international bachelor’s applicants usually target the English-taught BSc in Information and Communication Technology at the Kista campus, the hub of Stockholm’s tech industry.

You apply centrally through University Admissions in Sweden in Round 1 (deadline 15 January), uploading your school documents and English test by 1 February. Non-EU/EEA students pay tuition and a SEK 900 application fee, and KTH does not award scholarships at bachelor level, so budget carefully.

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK. Medicine and dentistry closed 15 Oct 2026.

tuition_intl.note: International fees are set per course and stay the same each year of the course; e.g. English Literature BA £27,300, engineering courses about £33,700. Placement/study-abroad year £4,575 (2027/28).

aid_intl.en: Up to £4.7m in international scholarships, including an automatic £5,000 International Undergraduate Regional Scholarship (first-year fee reduction) for passport holders of eligible countries/regions.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for most applicants (AP/SAT used in US-curriculum assessment). English: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5 (some courses 6.5–7.0); TOEFL iBT 80 (old scale) or 4.0 (tests from 21 Jan 2026), taken at a test centre.

summary.en: A large Russell Group university in the north of England, ranked 86th in the world by QS 2026. It is known for a huge course choice, a lively student city and strong links with industry.
summary.ka: დიდი რასელის ჯგუფის უნივერსიტეტი ჩრდილოეთ ინგლისში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 86-ე. ცნობილია კურსების უზარმაზარი არჩევანით, ცოცხალი სტუდენტური ქალაქით და ინდუსტრიასთან მჭიდრო კავშირებით.
summary.ar: جامعة كبيرة من مجموعة راسل في شمال إنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 86 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر بتنوع هائل في البرامج ومدينة طلابية نابضة وروابط قوية مع الصناعة.

about.en:
The University of Leeds is one of the UK’s largest universities, with a single city-centre campus and hundreds of undergraduate degrees across arts, business, engineering, environment, medicine and social sciences. Many courses offer an optional industrial placement or study-abroad year at a reduced fee.

Apply through UCAS by the January equal consideration date. Leeds sets the international fee per course and keeps it fixed for each year of study. Students from a long list of countries and regions receive an automatic £5,000 first-year scholarship.

tuition_intl.note: 2027/28 international fees by course: about £28,300 (e.g. Economics, International Relations) to £33,900 (e.g. Earth Sciences); Computer Science £33,000. Overseas fees rise annually for students starting from Aug 2026. Placement year 20%, study-abroad year 15% of fee.

aid_intl.en: Range of international scholarships for September 2027 starters, including undergraduate awards of £3,000 per year (up to £12,000) towards tuition; use the university’s scholarship finder.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT required for A-level/IB applicants. English: typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component (e.g. Computer Science); other tests listed on the English language pages.

summary.en: A Russell Group research university on England’s south coast, ranked 87th in the world by QS 2026. It is especially known for engineering, electronics and computer science, and ocean and earth sciences.
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ინგლისის სამხრეთ სანაპიროზე, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 87-ე. განსაკუთრებით ცნობილია ინჟინერიით, ელექტრონიკითა და კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით, ასევე ოკეანისა და დედამიწის მეცნიერებებით.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية من مجموعة راسل على الساحل الجنوبي لإنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 87 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر خصوصاً بالهندسة والإلكترونيات وعلوم الحاسوب وعلوم المحيطات والأرض.

about.en:
Southampton is a research-intensive Russell Group university with its main Highfield campus in the port city of Southampton and the National Oceanography Centre on the waterfront. Its School of Electronics and Computer Science, aeronautical and ship-science engineering, and ocean and earth sciences have strong international reputations.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are set by course, for example Computer Science BSc asks AAB including an A in maths, or IB 34 (17 at HL) with 6 in HL Mathematics. International fees for 2027/28 range from roughly £28,300 to £33,900 a year, and placement or study-abroad years are charged at a reduced rate.

aid_intl.en: No tuition; international students can apply for DAAD and foundation scholarships (e.g. Deutschlandstipendium after enrolment).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German: enrolment requires C1-level German (DSH-2, TestDaF 4×4, telc C1 Hochschule, DSD II or Goethe C2). Applicants whose school diploma does not give direct access must first complete a Studienkolleg (B2 German to apply).

summary.en: One of Berlin’s leading research universities, founded in 1948 and ranked 88th in the world by QS 2026. Bachelor’s degrees are tuition-free but taught in German.
summary.ka: ბერლინის ერთ-ერთი წამყვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი, დაარსებული 1948 წელს, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 88-ე. ბაკალავრიატი უფასოა, თუმცა სწავლება გერმანულ ენაზეა.
summary.ar: إحدى أبرز الجامعات البحثية في برلين، تأسست عام 1948 وتحتل المرتبة 88 عالمياً في QS 2026. الدراسة في البكالوريوس مجانية لكنها باللغة الألمانية.

about.en:
Freie Universität Berlin was founded in 1948 in West Berlin and is a German “University of Excellence”. From its leafy Dahlem campus it offers a wide range of bachelor’s programmes in humanities, social sciences, law, economics, natural sciences and mathematics, with particular strength in political science, area studies and history.

International applicants with a non-German school-leaving certificate first apply to uni-assist for a VPD (preliminary review), then submit the application in FU’s own portal by 15 July (restricted programmes) or 1 September (unrestricted). There are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution, but you need C1 German by enrolment.

aid_intl.en: International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027: £2,500 per year (up to £10,000), applied automatically as a fee discount to eligible overseas students who firm Sheffield by 2 June 2027 and keep a 60% average.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component for most courses (or GCSE English grade 4/C); other equivalent qualifications listed by the university.

summary.en: A Russell Group university in a green northern English city, ranked 92nd in the world by QS 2026. It is known for engineering, architecture and a highly rated students’ union.

summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل في مدينة خضراء بشمال إنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 92 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر بالهندسة والعمارة واتحاد طلابي متميز.

about.en:
The University of Sheffield is a research-intensive Russell Group university with a large engineering faculty, strong architecture, journalism and medicine, and a students’ union that regularly wins national awards. The city is compact, affordable by UK standards and next to the Peak District.

Apply through UCAS. Offers depend on the course, for example Computer Science BSc asks AAA (or AAB with an A in Maths and B in Computer Science) or IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths. Overseas fees for 2027 entry range from £27,650 to £34,670, and eligible international students receive an automatic £2,500-a-year scholarship.

summary.en: Sweden’s oldest university (founded 1477), ranked 93rd in the world by QS 2026. It offers nine English-taught bachelor’s programmes in Uppsala and in Visby on the island of Gotland.
summary.ka: შვედეთის უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი (დაარს. 1477), QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 93-ე. გთავაზობს ცხრა ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას უფსალაში და კუნძულ გოტლანდზე, ვისბიში.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في السويد (تأسست عام 1477)، تحتل المرتبة 93 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم تسعة برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية في أوبسالا وفي فيسبي بجزيرة غوتلاند.

about.en:
Uppsala University, founded in 1477, is a classic Scandinavian research university with strengths across the natural sciences, medicine, humanities and social sciences. For international bachelor’s students it offers nine English-taught programmes, most of them at Campus Gotland in the World Heritage town of Visby (for example Game Design and Programming, Energy Transition, Leadership – Quality Management – Improvement) and some in Uppsala (for example Theoretical Philosophy).

All applications go through universityadmissions.se by 15 January, with documents due 1 February. EU/EEA citizens study free; others pay tuition that varies by programme and a SEK 900 application fee.

Certified copies of school-leaving diploma and transcripts (with official translations if needed)
English 6 level (IELTS 6.5, no section below 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 90)
Application fee SEK 900 (non-EU/EEA only)

gpa_note.en: General entry requirements for Swedish first-cycle studies (completed upper-secondary education), plus programme-specific prerequisites.

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK. Medicine/dentistry closed 15 Oct 2026. Late applications are possible until 30 Jun 2027 where places remain.

tuition_intl.note: First-year international fee for Sept 2027 entry set per course, e.g. English Literature £30,000; international fees rise annually by up to the higher of 6% or CPI.

aid_intl.en: Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships (2027 entry): competitive tuition discounts of £5,000 or £10,000 per year for self-funded international students who make Durham their UCAS firm choice and submit the scholarship form.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: most courses Band B = IELTS 6.5 (no component under 6.0), TOEFL iBT 80 with no component under 20 (pre-2026 scale) or 4.5 on the new scale, Duolingo 120 (no sub-score under 110); Band A courses need IELTS 7.0 / Duolingo 130.

summary.en: A collegiate university in a historic cathedral city in north-east England, ranked 94th in the world by QS 2026. Students belong to colleges, and the university is known for humanities, law and natural sciences.
summary.ka: კოლეჯური უნივერსიტეტი ჩრდილო-აღმოსავლეთ ინგლისის ისტორიულ საკათედრო ქალაქში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 94-ე. სტუდენტები კოლეჯებს მიეკუთვნებიან, უნივერსიტეტი კი ცნობილია ჰუმანიტარული მეცნიერებებით, სამართლით და საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებებით.
summary.ar: جامعة كليات في مدينة كاتدرائية تاريخية شمال شرق إنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 94 عالمياً في QS 2026. ينتمي الطلاب إلى كليات، وتشتهر الجامعة بالعلوم الإنسانية والقانون والعلوم الطبيعية.

about.en:
Durham is England’s third-oldest university and, like Oxford and Cambridge, collegiate: every student joins one of its colleges for accommodation, sport and community. It is highly selective, with strong English, history, law, philosophy and politics, and a flexible Natural Sciences degree.

Apply through UCAS by the January deadline. Offers are high, for example English Literature asks A*AA. International fees are set per course (English Literature £30,000 for 2027 entry) and rise each year. Self-funded international students who firm Durham can compete for Inspiring Excellence Scholarships worth £5,000 or £10,000 a year.

scholarships.name: Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship (£5k or £10k per year)

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK. Medicine/dentistry closed 15 Oct 2026. Late applications are possible until 30 Jun 2027 where places remain.

tuition_intl.note: International fee is set per course; e.g. Computer Science BSc £33,500 per year for 2027 entry.

aid_intl.en: International Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship: an automatic £5,000 off first-year tuition for students who achieve AAA or the international equivalent; further undergraduate, sports and country scholarships.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS requirements are listed per course, commonly 6.5 with no element below 6.0 (e.g. Computer Science); PTE and TOEFL iBT also accepted.

summary.en: A Russell Group university with a famous parkland campus, ranked 97th in the world by QS 2026. Strong in pharmacy, engineering, economics and sport, it also runs campuses in Malaysia and China.
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის უნივერსიტეტი ცნობილი პარკის კამპუსით, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 97-ე. ძლიერია ფარმაციაში, ინჟინერიაში, ეკონომიკასა და სპორტში, ასევე აქვს კამპუსები მალაიზიასა და ჩინეთში.
summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل ذات حرم جامعي شهير وسط الحدائق، تحتل المرتبة 97 عالمياً في QS 2026. قوية في الصيدلة والهندسة والاقتصاد والرياضة، ولها فروع في ماليزيا والصين.

about.en:
The University of Nottingham is a Russell Group university whose University Park campus is one of the greenest in the UK; computer science sits on the nearby Jubilee Campus. It has strong pharmacy, engineering, economics, law and medicine, a big sports programme, and sister campuses in Malaysia and Ningbo, China.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific; Computer Science BSc asks AAA (AAB including A in computer science) or IB 34, and IELTS 6.5 with no element below 6.0. International students who achieve AAA or equivalent receive an automatic £5,000 first-year scholarship.

deadline_note: English-taught Mechanical Engineering (International) B.Sc.: first-semester deadline 30 April for the winter term. German-taught bachelor’s programmes (e.g. Informatics) close 15 July for non-EU applicants.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU international students pay €1,500 per semester tuition (Baden-Württemberg) plus administrative and student-services charges; the optional Carl Benz School College Program costs extra.

aid_intl.en: Few undergraduate scholarships; Deutschlandstipendium and DAAD options after enrolment. Exemptions from the €1,500 fee exist for some groups.

tests.en: Mechanical Engineering (International): one aptitude test required, SAT 1200+, ACT 24+ or TestAS core 75%+; English B2: TOEFL iBT 90 or IELTS 6.5 (no section below 5.5), or A-level English B / IB English 5. German-taught programmes need C1 German (DSH-2/TestDaF). APS certificate required for some countries.

summary.en: Germany’s technology-focused “University of Excellence” and national research centre, ranked 98th in the world by QS 2026. Most bachelor’s degrees are in German, but Mechanical Engineering (International) is taught in English.
summary.ka: გერმანიის ტექნოლოგიური „ბრწყინვალების უნივერსიტეტი“ და ეროვნული კვლევითი ცენტრი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 98-ე. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულ ენაზეა, თუმცა მანქანათმშენებლობა (საერთაშორისო) ინგლისურად ისწავლება.
summary.ar: جامعة التميز الألمانية ذات التوجه التقني ومركز بحثي وطني، تحتل المرتبة 98 عالمياً في QS 2026. معظم برامج البكالوريوس بالألمانية، لكن برنامج الهندسة الميكانيكية (الدولي) يُدرَّس بالإنجليزية.

about.en:
KIT merges the University of Karlsruhe with a national Helmholtz research centre, making it one of Europe’s largest science and engineering institutions. It is especially strong in mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering, informatics and physics. Its English-taught Mechanical Engineering (International) B.Sc. (125 places) is run with the Carl Benz School and adds German courses and orientation support.

For that programme you upload four documents online by 30 April: your school-leaving certificate, an aptitude test (SAT 1200+, ACT 24+ or TestAS 75%+), a motivation letter and an English certificate. German-taught programmes such as Informatics close on 15 July and require C1 German. Non-EU students pay €1,500 per semester.

English B2 (TOEFL iBT 90 / IELTS 6.5) for the English programme, or German C1 for German-taught degrees

gpa_note.en: School certificate equivalent to German university entrance; for Mechanical Engineering (International) a minimum SAT 1200 / ACT 24 / TestAS 75% and good maths and physics.

deadline_note: Admission to Engineering BSc programmes is through the TOL online test (or SAT / TOLC / English TOLC) in several sessions; the 2027/28 call for admission has not been published yet (2026/27 call online). Non-EU applicants also need a visa pre-enrolment on Universitaly.

tuition_intl.note: Fees depend on family income (ISEE/ISEEU): from €157.04 to a maximum of €3,943.04 per year for a standard study plan; first instalment €880.04.

aid_intl.en: Income-based DSU (Diritto allo Studio) scholarships with fee waiver and allowance; Polimi scholarships for international students on selected English-taught BSc programmes.

tests.en: Engineering BSc entrance test: TOL (Polimi, in Italian), TOLC-I, English TOLC (CISIA) or the SAT (accepted as an alternative test). English-taught programmes require proof of English before enrolment (certificate, English-medium schooling or English-speaking citizenship); Italian-taught programmes require Italian proficiency.

summary.en: Italy’s largest technical university and one of Europe’s best for engineering, architecture and design, ranked 98th in the world by QS 2026. Tuition is income-based and capped below €4,000 a year.
summary.ka: იტალიის უდიდესი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი და ევროპის ერთ-ერთი საუკეთესო ინჟინერიის, არქიტექტურისა და დიზაინის მიმართულებით, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 98-ე. სწავლის საფასური შემოსავალზეა დამოკიდებული და წელიწადში 4,000 ევროს არ აღემატება.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة تقنية في إيطاليا ومن أفضل جامعات أوروبا في الهندسة والعمارة والتصميم، تحتل المرتبة 98 عالمياً في QS 2026. الرسوم مرتبطة بدخل الأسرة ولا تتجاوز 4,000 يورو سنوياً.

about.en:
Politecnico di Milano is a public university with around 49,000 students across schools of engineering, architecture, design and urban planning, with campuses in Milan and northern Italian cities such as Como, Cremona, Lecco, Mantua and Piacenza. It ranks among the world’s top 20 for engineering, architecture and art & design subjects.

Applicants with foreign qualifications apply online. For engineering you sit the TOL test or submit an accepted alternative such as the SAT; architecture and design have their own tests. Most bachelor’s degrees are taught in Italian, with a smaller set in English. Fees depend on family income and top out at about €3,943 a year.

deadline_note: Fall 2027 bachelor’s: applicants who need a visa apply 1 Jan – 28 Feb 2027; other applicants with foreign qualifications by 30 Apr 2027. Deadlines cannot be extended.

tuition_intl.note: CHF 720 tuition + CHF 500 surcharge for foreign bachelor’s students per semester, plus about CHF 59 mandatory contributions; application fee CHF 150 for foreign qualifications.

aid_intl.en: Very low tuition; limited need-based support for students in financial difficulty. No dedicated bachelor’s scholarships for international applicants.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are mainly taught in German: C1 German proof required (TestDaF, DSH, Goethe C1/C2, etc.). Foreign school certificates must meet Swiss subject requirements (first language, foreign language, maths, sciences, humanities); otherwise an entrance exam may be required.

summary.en: Switzerland’s largest university, ranked 100th in the world by QS 2026, with leading medicine, economics and life sciences. Bachelor’s degrees are taught mainly in German at very low tuition.
summary.ka: შვეიცარიის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში მე-100, წამყვანი მედიცინით, ეკონომიკითა და სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებებით. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულ ენაზეა და ძალიან დაბალი საფასურით.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في سويسرا، تحتل المرتبة 100 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز بالطب والاقتصاد وعلوم الحياة. يُدرَّس البكالوريوس أساساً بالألمانية برسوم منخفضة جداً.

about.en:
The University of Zurich is Switzerland’s largest university, sharing the city with ETH Zurich. It covers law, economics, medicine, veterinary medicine, sciences and humanities, and its research in life sciences, economics and medicine is internationally prominent.

International applicants must hold a school certificate that meets Swiss subject requirements and show C1 German for German-taught programmes. Applications are made online; visa-required applicants must apply by the end of February. Tuition is only about CHF 1,220 per semester for foreign bachelor’s students, but Zurich’s living costs are high.

tuition_intl.note: 2027/28 non-EU institutional fee: €15,100 (humanities/social sciences), €18,700 (sciences, AI, Liberal Arts & Sciences), €29,400 (medicine, pharmacy, veterinary); PPE €17,900. EU statutory fee €2,771. Application fee €100.

aid_intl.en: Utrecht scholarships are limited at bachelor level (e.g. Philosophy, Politics and Economics scholarship, Martijn Zwart Fund); US and Canadian loans accepted.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for most programmes. English (EMI-ready level): IELTS Academic 6.0 (speaking 5.5, listening 6.0, reading 6.0, writing 5.5), TOEFL iBT 83 (pre-2026) or 4.5 (new scale), Cambridge C1 169. Some programmes require higher EMI levels.

summary.en: One of the Netherlands’ oldest and largest research universities, ranked 103rd in the world by QS 2026. It offers English-taught bachelor’s degrees including liberal arts, PPE and sustainability science.
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდების ერთ-ერთი უძველესი და უდიდესი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 103-ე. გთავაზობს ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატს, მათ შორის ლიბერალურ ხელოვნებას, PPE-სა და მდგრადობის მეცნიერებას.
summary.ar: من أقدم وأكبر الجامعات البحثية في هولندا، تحتل المرتبة 103 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية منها الفنون الحرة والفلسفة والسياسة والاقتصاد وعلوم الاستدامة.

about.en:
Utrecht University, founded in 1636, is a broad research university in a historic canal city 30 minutes from Amsterdam. Its English-taught bachelor’s options include University College Utrecht (a residential liberal arts college), Philosophy, Politics and Economics, Global Sustainability Science and several others, and it is especially strong in geosciences, veterinary medicine, psychology and sustainability.

You start in Studielink, then upload documents and pay the €100 fee in Utrecht’s own system. Selective programmes close on 15 January. Non-EU students pay institutional fees from €15,100 to €29,400 a year for 2027/28, depending on the programme.

platform: Direct (RWTH Online) – some applicants via uni-assist
deadline_note: Winter semester 2027/28: bachelor’s programmes with restricted admission (NC) and medicine accept applications 1 May – 15 July; unrestricted bachelor’s programmes 1 May – 20 Oct. Standing RWTH deadlines; non-EU applicants should apply early for visa reasons.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees in North Rhine-Westphalia; a semester social contribution (incl. public-transport ticket) is payable each semester.

aid_intl.en: No tuition. Scholarships such as the Deutschlandstipendium and DAAD programmes are available after enrolment.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German: proof of German (DSH-2, TestDaF 4×4 or equivalent C1) required. Foreign school certificates must give direct university access in Germany; otherwise a Studienkolleg is needed first.

summary.en: Germany’s largest technical university and a “University of Excellence”, ranked 105th in the world by QS 2026. Engineering degrees are tuition-free but taught in German.
summary.ka: გერმანიის უდიდესი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი და „ბრწყინვალების უნივერსიტეტი“, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 105-ე. საინჟინრო ბაკალავრიატი უფასოა, მაგრამ გერმანულ ენაზე ისწავლება.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة تقنية في ألمانيا وإحدى جامعات التميز، تحتل المرتبة 105 عالمياً في QS 2026. الدراسة الهندسية مجانية لكنها باللغة الألمانية.

about.en:
RWTH Aachen is Germany’s largest university of technology and a member of the TU9 group, with close ties to industry in mechanical, electrical, automotive and production engineering. It sits in Aachen on the borders of Belgium and the Netherlands.

Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German, so international applicants need C1-level German and a school certificate that qualifies for direct university admission (or a Studienkolleg). There are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution. Restricted programmes close on 15 July for the winter semester.

deadline_note: BSc in General Engineering (English-taught): quota 2 deadline 15 Mar 2027, 12:00 noon, incl. personal statement; application fee also due 15 Mar; documentation of final exams by 5 July.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students pay €7,500 per semester (paid up front each semester); application fee €100.

aid_intl.en: DTU offers no scholarships or tuition fee waivers at undergraduate level.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Subject requirements (Danish levels): Mathematics A, Physics B, Chemistry B, English B. English test: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 88 (or 4.5 on the post-Jan-2026 scale), Cambridge C1/C2 180; IB and European Bac holders are exempt.

summary.en: Denmark’s leading engineering university near Copenhagen, ranked 107th in the world by QS 2026. Its only English-taught bachelor’s is the BSc in General Engineering.
summary.ka: დანიის წამყვანი საინჟინრო უნივერსიტეტი კოპენჰაგენთან ახლოს, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 107-ე. ერთადერთი ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატია BSc ზოგად ინჟინერიაში.
summary.ar: أبرز جامعة هندسية في الدنمارك قرب كوبنهاغن، تحتل المرتبة 107 عالمياً في QS 2026. برنامج البكالوريوس الوحيد بالإنجليزية هو بكالوريوس الهندسة العامة.

about.en:
DTU is a technical university on a large campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, with strong research in energy, biotechnology, space, and computing. Most of its bachelor’s engineering degrees are taught in Danish; international students apply to the English-taught BSc in General Engineering, which combines a broad science and engineering foundation with later specialisation.

Applications go through Denmark’s national portal under quota 2 by 15 March, with a personal statement and proof of maths, physics, chemistry and English levels. Non-EU students pay €7,500 per semester, and DTU offers no undergraduate scholarships.

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK. Medicine/dentistry closed 15 Oct 2026. Late applications are possible until 30 Jun 2027 where places remain.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by course; e.g. Economics BSc £30,950 for 2027 entry (£26,750 with integrated foundation year). Fees for international students may rise by a standard inflationary amount each year.

aid_intl.en: Scholarships for international students include fee reductions, plus means-tested and subject-specific funding; Queen Mary says around half of undergraduates receive a scholarship or bursary.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English requirements are set per course on Queen Mary’s English language entry requirements page; pre-sessional English is available.

summary.en: A Russell Group university in East London, ranked 110th in the world by QS 2026, with a self-contained campus and the historic Barts medical school.
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის უნივერსიტეტი აღმოსავლეთ ლონდონში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 110-ე, დახურული კამპუსითა და ისტორიული Barts-ის სამედიცინო სკოლით.
summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل في شرق لندن، تحتل المرتبة 110 عالمياً في QS 2026، ولها حرم متكامل وكلية الطب العريقة Barts.

about.en:
Queen Mary University of London is a Russell Group university with one of London’s few self-contained residential campuses at Mile End, plus medical and dental schools (Barts and The London) in Whitechapel. It is known for law, economics, medicine, dentistry, engineering and the humanities, and has a very diverse student body.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific, for example Economics BSc asks AAA including Maths or IB 36 with 6,6,6 at Higher Level. International fees vary by course and include optional year-abroad and industry variants.

deadline_note: UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry is 13 Jan 2027 (medicine 15 Oct 2026, closed). St Andrews also accepts the Common Application and direct applications from overseas students; applicants by the equal consideration deadline get a decision by May.

tuition_intl.note: Overseas fee for 2026/27 entrants: £33,250 per year (Arts, Divinity, Science); Medicine £39,620. Fees rise annually, typically by 3–5%; 2027/28 figures not yet published.

aid_intl.en: A large number of bursaries and scholarships, including international scholarships covering full or partial tuition; apply through My Application after applying.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT needed for A-level/IB applicants (US applicants may use SAT/ACT/AP). English test required if English is not your first language (scores listed on the English language requirements pages).

summary.en: Scotland’s first university (founded 1413), ranked 113th in the world by QS 2026. It is a small, highly selective seaside university with four-year Scottish MA and BSc degrees and a joint degree with William & Mary.
summary.ka: შოტლანდიის პირველი უნივერსიტეტი (დაარს. 1413), QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 113-ე. პატარა, მაღალშერჩევითი ზღვისპირა უნივერსიტეტი ოთხწლიანი შოტლანდიური MA/BSc ხარისხებით და William & Mary-სთან ერთობლივი პროგრამით.
summary.ar: أول جامعة في اسكتلندا (تأسست عام 1413)، تحتل المرتبة 113 عالمياً في QS 2026. جامعة ساحلية صغيرة وانتقائية جداً تمنح درجات MA وBSc اسكتلندية مدتها أربع سنوات وبرنامجاً مشتركاً مع William & Mary.

about.en:
St Andrews is a small, historic university in a coastal town in Fife, known for international relations, economics, physics, classics and a strong residential community. Degrees follow the flexible four-year Scottish model, and the International Honours programme lets students split their degree with William & Mary in the USA.

You can apply through UCAS, the Common App or directly. Standard offers are high: Economics asks AAA at A-level or IB 38 (6,6,6 HL), with minimum entry grades of ABB / IB 36 for widening-access applicants. Overseas fees were £33,250 for 2026 entrants and rise each year.

deadline_note: Application period for English-taught bachelor’s: 7–22 Jan 2027. In SAT/ACT-based round A, scores must reach Aalto by 29 Jan 2027 15:00 (UTC+2); results by 31 Mar 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA tuition: €12,000/yr (business, technology, Technology-Business-Design), €15,000/yr (art & architecture). EU/EEA free. Studyinfo application fee applies to non-EU applicants.

aid_intl.en: Aalto University Excellence Scholarships: competitive full tuition waivers for the top applicants (living costs not covered, at least €800/month); first-year discounts for some new students.

tests.en: Applicants with a regular high-school diploma apply in round A on SAT or ACT (tests from 1 Jan 2025): Economics, Finance and International Business need SAT 1200+ or ACT 25+; Science & Technology and Technology-Business-Design need SAT 1350+ (Math 700+) or ACT 29+ (Math 30+). IB/EB holders are assessed on certificate grades (round B). No separate English test required for round A.

summary.en: Finland’s top university for technology, business and design, ranked 114th in the world by QS 2026. Its English-taught bachelor’s degrees admit most international applicants on SAT or ACT scores.
summary.ka: ფინეთის საუკეთესო უნივერსიტეტი ტექნოლოგიების, ბიზნესისა და დიზაინის მიმართულებით, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 114-ე. ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატზე საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტების უმეტესობა SAT-ის ან ACT-ის ქულებით ირიცხება.
summary.ar: أفضل جامعة في فنلندا للتكنولوجيا والأعمال والتصميم، تحتل المرتبة 114 عالمياً في QS 2026. يُقبل معظم المتقدمين الدوليين لبرامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية بناءً على نتائج SAT أو ACT.

about.en:
Aalto University was created in 2010 by merging Helsinki’s technology, business and art schools, and its Otaniemi campus in Espoo is a startup hotspot. It offers six English-taught bachelor’s programmes, including Science and Technology, Economics, Finance, International Business, Technology-Business-Design and Design and Media, and graduates get an automatic right to continue to selected master’s programmes.

You apply on Studyinfo during 7–22 January. Most international applicants are admitted on SAT/ACT scores, with clear minimums; IB and EB holders compete on their diploma grades. Non-EU students pay €12,000–15,000 a year, but strong applicants can win full tuition waivers.

deadline_note: Autumn 2027: Admission group 1 (SAT/ACT-based, most international diplomas) applies 5–19 Jan 2027 (closes 15:00 UTC+2); Admission group 2 (Finnish matriculation, IB, EB, etc.) applies 9–23 Mar 2027. You can only apply in one period.

tuition_intl.note: English-taught bachelor’s programmes cost €13,000 per year for non-EU/EEA students; EU/EEA free.

aid_intl.en: University of Helsinki Scholarship Programme for excellent tuition-fee-liable students (tuition fee waivers).

tests.en: Admission group 1 is ranked on SAT or ACT scores (total of two tests may be considered), so SAT/ACT is effectively required for applicants with most international diplomas; IB/EB holders are ranked on diploma grades (group 2). English language requirement must be met (see university’s language requirements).

summary.en: Finland’s oldest and largest university, ranked 116th in the world by QS 2026. It offers two English-taught bachelor’s programmes, Liberal Arts and Sciences and Science, with SAT/ACT-based admission for most international applicants.
summary.ka: ფინეთის უძველესი და უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 116-ე. გთავაზობს ორ ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას, ლიბერალურ ხელოვნებასა და მეცნიერებებს და საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებას; საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტების უმეტესობა SAT/ACT-ით ირიცხება.
summary.ar: أقدم وأكبر جامعة في فنلندا، تحتل المرتبة 116 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم برنامجين للبكالوريوس بالإنجليزية هما الفنون الحرة والعلوم، والعلوم، ويُقبل معظم المتقدمين الدوليين بناءً على SAT/ACT.

about.en:
The University of Helsinki is a multidisciplinary research university in the centre of Finland’s capital. Most bachelor’s degrees are in Finnish or Swedish, but two interdisciplinary programmes are taught in English: Liberal Arts and Sciences, which mixes natural sciences, social sciences and humanities, and Science, which lets you explore physics, chemistry, maths, computer science and geosciences before specialising.

Applicants with most international diplomas apply 5–19 January and are ranked on SAT or ACT results; IB and EB holders apply in March on their grades. Non-EU students pay €13,000 a year, and top applicants can receive tuition waivers.

platform: Direct (UCD online application) for non-EU; CAO for EU fee status
deadline_note: Non-EU applications open from 1 October for the following September and are assessed on a rolling basis; visa-required students are advised to apply before 1 July 2027. Apply early if you want to be considered for scholarships.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU undergraduate fees vary by programme; see the UCD Fees Office 2027/28 international undergraduate fee grid. Application fee €70.

aid_intl.en: Full and partial scholarships for non-EU fee students, including the UCD Global Excellence Scholarship; North American federal loans accepted.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required but considered for US-curriculum applicants (unweighted GPA 3.2 plus AP/SAT/ACT also considered). English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (6.0 in each band), TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 21, others 19) or 4.5 on the new scale, Duolingo 120 (110 in each sub-score), Cambridge C1/C2 accepted.

summary.en: Ireland’s largest university, on a big parkland campus in south Dublin, ranked 118th in the world by QS 2026. Non-EU students apply directly online on a rolling basis, with a €70 fee.
summary.ka: ირლანდიის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი სამხრეთ დუბლინის დიდ პარკულ კამპუსზე, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 118-ე. ევროკავშირის გარეთა სტუდენტები პირდაპირ ონლაინ, მოძრავი წესით აპლიკირებენ, 70 ევროს საფასურით.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في أيرلندا في حرم واسع جنوب دبلن، تحتل المرتبة 118 عالمياً في QS 2026. يتقدم الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي مباشرة عبر الإنترنت وبنظام القبول المتجدد، برسوم 70 يورو.

about.en:
University College Dublin is Ireland’s largest university, based on the Belfield campus in south Dublin. It is known for business (Quinn School / Smurfit), engineering, computer science, medicine, veterinary medicine, agriculture and law, and offers a Liberal Arts and Sciences pathway and an International Foundation Year.

Students with non-EU fee status apply directly online from 1 October, with country-specific entry requirements (for US students, a 3.2 unweighted GPA, with SAT/ACT/AP considered). English minimums are IELTS 6.5 or equivalent. Dublin is one of Europe’s tech hubs, which helps with internships.

tuition_intl.note: Full tuition for bachelor’s and master’s programmes is €300–1,500 per year depending on country of residence (or ISEE income for residents); pre-selection fee €30 per application (max 2).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. High-school diploma after at least 12 years of schooling; English proficiency for English-taught programmes; non-EU visa applicants to Italian-taught programmes need certified Italian B2.

summary.en: One of Europe’s largest and oldest universities (founded 1303), ranked 128th in the world by QS 2026. It offers 8 English-taught bachelor’s programmes with tuition of €300–1,500 a year.
summary.ka: ევროპის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი და უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი (დაარს. 1303), QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 128-ე. გთავაზობს 8 ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას, წლიური საფასურით 300–1,500 ევრო.
summary.ar: من أكبر جامعات أوروبا وأقدمها (تأسست عام 1303)، تحتل المرتبة 128 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم 8 برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية برسوم بين 300 و1,500 يورو سنوياً.

about.en:
Sapienza is Rome’s historic public university, founded in 1303, with a huge range of programmes across humanities, sciences, engineering, medicine and architecture. It is especially strong in classics, archaeology, physics and engineering, and offers 8 bachelor’s and about 45 master’s programmes taught entirely in English.

International students apply for English-taught degrees through an online pre-selection (€30 per application) months before the official calls, then complete visa pre-enrolment on Universitaly. Tuition is low: €300–1,500 a year depending on your country of residence.

summary.en: Denmark’s second-largest university, ranked 131st in the world by QS 2026. It runs a handful of English-taught bachelor’s degrees in business, computing and data science.
summary.ka: დანიის მეორე უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 131-ე. გთავაზობს რამდენიმე ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას ბიზნესში, კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებასა და მონაცემთა მეცნიერებაში.
summary.ar: ثاني أكبر جامعة في الدنمارك، تحتل المرتبة 131 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم عدداً من برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية في الأعمال والحوسبة وعلوم البيانات.

about.en:
Aarhus University is a large research university in Denmark’s second city, with strong economics and business (Aarhus BSS), computer science, natural sciences and health. Its English-taught bachelor’s programmes include Economics and Business Administration (Aarhus and Herning), Computer Science, Data Science and IT Product Development; Cognitive Science is expected to switch to Danish in 2027.

All international applicants apply on Denmark’s national portal by 15 March. Non-EU students pay tuition per programme plus a €150 application fee, and the university offers no bachelor’s scholarships.

aid_intl.en: Bath International Excellence Scholarship (Sept 2027 entry): £8,000 per year off tuition (up to £24,000) for overseas-fee offer holders who firm Bath; apply in the Application Tracker, rounds close 14 Feb and 31 Mar 2027.

summary.en: A campus university on a hill above the World Heritage city of Bath, ranked 132nd in the world by QS 2026. It is known for placements with industry, engineering, management and sport.
summary.ka: კამპუსური უნივერსიტეტი ბორცვზე, მსოფლიო მემკვიდრეობის ქალაქ ბათის თავზე, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 132-ე. ცნობილია ინდუსტრიული პრაქტიკებით, ინჟინერიით, მენეჯმენტითა და სპორტით.
summary.ar: جامعة حرمية على تلة تطل على مدينة باث المدرجة في التراث العالمي، تحتل المرتبة 132 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر بالتدريب العملي في الصناعة والهندسة والإدارة والرياضة.

about.en:
The University of Bath is a compact, highly ranked campus university known for its year-long industry placements, which many degrees include. It is strong in economics, management, engineering, architecture, computer science and sport, and its Claverton Down campus overlooks the Georgian city of Bath.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are high: Economics asks A*AA including Maths (contextual AAB) or IB 36 with 7,6,6 at HL including Maths. Overseas students can win an £8,000-a-year International Excellence Scholarship after receiving an offer.

summary.en: A Russell Group university in the heart of a lively northern city, ranked 137th in the world by QS 2026. International students can receive a £7,000-a-year scholarship automatically.
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის უნივერსიტეტი ჩრდილოეთის ცოცხალი ქალაქის ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 137-ე. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ავტომატურად შეიძლება მიიღონ წელიწადში 7,000 ფუნტიანი სტიპენდია.
summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل في قلب مدينة شمالية نابضة، تحتل المرتبة 137 عالمياً في QS 2026. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين الحصول تلقائياً على منحة بقيمة 7,000 جنيه سنوياً.

about.en:
Newcastle University is a Russell Group university with a city-centre campus in Newcastle upon Tyne. It has a long-established medical school and is strong in architecture, engineering, computing, business and agriculture, with campuses also in Malaysia and Singapore.

Apply through UCAS by 13 January to be automatically considered for the Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship worth £7,000 a year. International fees are lower than many Russell Group peers (Economics BSc £25,750 a year).

aid_intl.en: No dedicated TU/e scholarships for bachelor’s students (TU/e scholarships target master’s programmes).

summary.en: A Dutch technical university at the heart of the Brainport tech region, ranked 140th in the world by QS 2026. Its Bachelor College lets engineering students shape a flexible programme.
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდების ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი Brainport-ის ტექნოლოგიური რეგიონის გულში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 140-ე. მისი Bachelor College საინჟინრო სტუდენტებს მოქნილი პროგრამის აწყობის საშუალებას აძლევს.
summary.ar: جامعة تقنية هولندية في قلب منطقة Brainport التقنية، تحتل المرتبة 140 عالمياً في QS 2026. تتيح كلية البكالوريوس فيها لطلاب الهندسة بناء برنامج مرن.

about.en:
TU/e is a compact, campus-based technical university in Eindhoven, next to high-tech companies such as ASML and Philips. Its Bachelor College combines a major with electives and design projects across mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering, computer science, applied physics, industrial design and biomedical engineering.

You register in Studielink and complete the application in TU/e’s portal. Selective programmes close on 15 January and others on 1 May. Non-EU tuition rises to €22,400 for 2027/28, and there are no TU/e bachelor’s scholarships.

summary.en: A founding Russell Group university in a famous port city, ranked 147th in the world by QS 2026. It is known for medicine, veterinary science, engineering and a campus in China (XJTLU).
summary.ka: რასელის ჯგუფის დამფუძნებელი უნივერსიტეტი ცნობილ საპორტო ქალაქში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 147-ე. ცნობილია მედიცინით, ვეტერინარიით, ინჟინერიით და ჩინეთში პარტნიორული კამპუსით (XJTLU).
summary.ar: جامعة مؤسِّسة في مجموعة راسل في مدينة ميناء شهيرة، تحتل المرتبة 147 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر بالطب والطب البيطري والهندسة وحرم شريك في الصين (XJTLU).

about.en:
The University of Liverpool is one of the original red-brick universities, with a city-centre campus and long-standing strengths in medicine, veterinary science, life sciences, engineering, architecture and law. It co-founded Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University in China.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific, for example Economics BSc asks AAB including A in Maths, or IB 34 with 6 in HL Maths. International fees are moderate for a Russell Group university (£28,000 for Economics in 2027/28).

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU institutional fees vary by programme (see the RUG tuition fee page); EU students pay the Dutch statutory fee. An application fee applies to applicants with non-Dutch qualifications.

aid_intl.en: Limited bachelor’s scholarships for non-EU students; check programme pages and the university scholarship overview.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. English test results and subject requirements (e.g. maths) are set in the bachelor’s application documents and programme pages.

summary.en: One of the oldest universities in the Netherlands (1614), ranked 147th in the world by QS 2026. It offers 34 English-taught bachelor’s programmes in a lively student city.
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდების ერთ-ერთი უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი (1614), QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 147-ე. ცოცხალ სტუდენტურ ქალაქში გთავაზობს 34 ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას.
summary.ar: من أقدم الجامعات في هولندا (1614)، تحتل المرتبة 147 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم 34 برنامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية في مدينة طلابية نابضة.

about.en:
The University of Groningen is a comprehensive research university founded in 1614 in the northern Dutch city of Groningen, where students make up a large part of the population. It offers 34 English-taught bachelor’s programmes, from International Business, Psychology and Econometrics to Artificial Intelligence, International Relations, law and a liberal arts college (University College Groningen), plus programmes at Campus Fryslân.

Apply via Studielink. Numerus fixus programmes such as International Business and Psychology close on 15 January, and regular programmes on 1 May.

tuition_intl.note: Bachelor tuition 2027/28: €18,840 for non-EU students; €2,771 EU/EEA statutory fee (2026/27: €18,300 / €2,694).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. English and subject requirements (often maths, chemistry or biology) are set per programme on WUR’s admission requirement pages.

summary.en: The world’s leading university for agriculture, food and environmental sciences, ranked 153rd overall by QS 2026. It offers 8 English-taught bachelor’s programmes in a small campus town.
summary.ka: მსოფლიოს წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი სოფლის მეურნეობის, კვებისა და გარემოს მეცნიერებებში, QS 2026-ში საერთო რეიტინგით 153-ე. პატარა საუნივერსიტეტო ქალაქში გთავაზობს 8 ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამას.
summary.ar: الجامعة الرائدة عالمياً في الزراعة والغذاء والعلوم البيئية، تحتل المرتبة 153 إجمالاً في QS 2026. تقدم 8 برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية في بلدة جامعية صغيرة.

about.en:
Wageningen University & Research specialises in life sciences: food, agriculture, environment, nutrition, biotechnology and sustainable land and water use, and it regularly tops global subject rankings in agriculture. About 14,000 students from around 120 nationalities study on its green campus in Wageningen.

WUR offers 8 English-taught bachelor’s programmes. Non-EU applicants register in Studielink by 15 April and complete their file by 1 May; non-EU tuition is €18,840 for 2027/28.

summary.en: A Russell Group university in south-west England, ranked 155th in the world by QS 2026. It offers 150 generous Excellence Scholarships of £15,000 a year for international undergraduates.

summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل في جنوب غرب إنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 155 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقدم 150 منحة تميز سخية بقيمة 15,000 جنيه سنوياً لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين.

about.en:
The University of Exeter is a Russell Group university with its main Streatham Campus in Exeter and a second campus in Cornwall focused on environment and sustainability. It is known for business, economics, politics, law, psychology and environmental and climate science.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks A*AA–AAB at A-level (with maths) or IB 36–38. International fees are relatively moderate, and Exeter Excellence Scholarships of £15,000 a year (150 awards for 2027 entry) are open to offer holders who apply early.

summary.en: A collegiate campus university in north-west England, ranked 157th in the world by QS 2026. It is especially known for its management school and its college system.

about.en:
Lancaster University is a campus university near the historic city of Lancaster and the Lake District, organised into colleges that give students a smaller community. Lancaster University Management School is highly regarded, and the university is also strong in economics, accounting and finance, physics, linguistics and environmental science.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB with Maths or IB 35 (16 at HL incl. 6 in HL Maths); the standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 in each element.

about.en:
The University of York is a Russell Group university with a collegiate system on a parkland campus just outside the medieval city of York. It is well known for economics, politics, history, English, computer science and environment, and for small-group teaching.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB (Maths preferred) or IB 35 with HL5/SL7 Maths, and IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 per component. Overseas-fee offer holders from many countries automatically receive a £5,000-a-year York International Undergraduate Scholarship.

about.en:
The University of Reading has a large parkland campus at Whiteknights, about 25 minutes by train from London. It is internationally known for meteorology and climate science, Henley Business School, real estate and planning, agriculture and food science.

Apply through UCAS. BSc Economics asks ABB (maths preferred) or IB 32 with 5 in SL Maths. Reading’s Global Sustainability Leaders Scholarship gives up to 400 students £6,000 a year towards living costs.

Loughborough University is a single-site campus university best known worldwide for sport-related subjects, and also strong in engineering, design, business and economics. Many degrees include an optional salaried placement year that leads to an extra Diploma in Professional Studies.

Apply through UCAS. Economics and Finance asks AAA or IB 37 with 6,6,6 at HL, and the standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each element.

summary.en: Ireland’s southern university in the lively city of Cork, ranked 246th in the world by QS 2026. Non-EU students apply directly online with a €50 fee and a 31 May deadline.

about.en:
University College Cork is a research university on a riverside campus in Cork, Ireland’s second city. It is strong in medicine and health sciences, pharmacy, law, business, food science and computer science, and Cork is a hub for pharmaceutical and tech companies.

Students with non-EU qualifications apply through UCCApply from 1 December, with a general deadline of 31 May (earlier for pharmacy and psychology). A-level and IB minimums are published per programme, and English tests must come from a single sitting.

summary.en: A technological university in the centre of Glasgow, ranked 251st in the world by QS 2026. It is known for engineering, business and practical, industry-linked degrees.
summary.ka: ტექნოლოგიური უნივერსიტეტი გლაზგოს ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 251-ე. ცნობილია ინჟინერიით, ბიზნესით და ინდუსტრიასთან დაკავშირებული პრაქტიკული პროგრამებით.
summary.ar: جامعة تقنية في وسط غلاسكو، تحتل المرتبة 251 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر بالهندسة وإدارة الأعمال والبرامج العملية المرتبطة بالصناعة.

about.en:
The University of Strathclyde is a city-centre university in Glasgow focused on “useful learning”, with a large engineering faculty, the Strathclyde Business School, pharmacy, law and economics. Scottish honours degrees normally last four years, with second-year entry possible for strong A-level/IB applicants.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks ABB–BBB at A-level or IB 30–32 (no subject below 5). International fees are lower than many UK peers.

summary.en: A campus university in Guildford near London, ranked 262nd in the world by QS 2026, with a strong professional training (placement) year culture.

summary.ar: جامعة حرمية في غيلدفورد قرب لندن، تحتل المرتبة 262 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز بثقافة قوية لسنة التدريب المهني.

about.en:
The University of Surrey sits on a hillside campus in Guildford, 35 minutes from London. It is known for its Professional Training placement year, hospitality and tourism management, engineering, economics, health sciences and veterinary medicine.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB (ABB with A-level Maths or Economics) or IB 34, and IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in writing. International fees are relatively moderate at £22,700 for Economics.

English: TOEFL iBT or PTE Academic at registration, or METU’s English Proficiency Exam (otherwise a one-year prep year); IELTS taken after 24 Dec 2022 is not accepted.

summary.en: Türkiye’s leading English-medium technical university, on a large forested campus in Ankara, ranked 269th in the world by QS 2026. International students are admitted on SAT, ACT, IB, A-level or national diploma scores.
summary.ka: თურქეთის წამყვანი ინგლისურენოვანი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი ანკარაში, დიდ ტყიან კამპუსზე, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 269-ე. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ირიცხებიან SAT, ACT, IB, A-level ან ეროვნული ატესტატის ქულებით.
summary.ar: الجامعة التقنية الرائدة في تركيا بلغة التدريس الإنجليزية، في حرم واسع مشجر في أنقرة، تحتل المرتبة 269 عالمياً في QS 2026. يُقبل الطلاب الدوليون بناءً على درجات SAT أو ACT أو IB أو A-level أو الشهادات الوطنية.

about.en:
METU (ODTÜ) is a public university in Ankara where all teaching is in English. It is Türkiye’s best-known engineering school and also strong in architecture, sciences, economics and administrative sciences, with a large campus that includes its own forest and lake.

International applicants apply online in a summer window (June–July in 2026) with one qualifying score: for example SAT 1200 (Math 700 for engineering), ACT 27, IB 33 or A-levels ABB. Students without an accepted English score at registration take METU’s exam or a preparatory English year.

Valid passport

summary.en: A campus university near Brighton on England’s south coast, ranked 278th in the world by QS 2026. It is especially known for development studies, international relations and social sciences.
summary.ka: კამპუსური უნივერსიტეტი ბრაიტონთან, ინგლისის სამხრეთ სანაპიროზე, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 278-ე. განსაკუთრებით ცნობილია განვითარების კვლევებით, საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებით და სოციალური მეცნიერებებით.
summary.ar: جامعة حرمية قرب برايتون على الساحل الجنوبي لإنجلترا، تحتل المرتبة 278 عالمياً في QS 2026. تشتهر خصوصاً بدراسات التنمية والعلاقات الدولية والعلوم الاجتماعية.

about.en:
The University of Sussex has a modernist campus on the edge of the South Downs, a short train ride from Brighton. It is internationally known for development studies (with the Institute of Development Studies), international relations, economics, psychology and media.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks ABB–BBB or IB 32 and IELTS 6.0. International students can receive Global Flourishing awards worth £5,000–6,000 off first-year tuition.

summary.en: A technology-focused university with a campus outside Edinburgh and branches in Dubai and Malaysia, ranked 287th in the world by QS 2026. It offers relatively accessible entry and lower fees.

about.en:
Heriot-Watt University is a specialist in science, engineering, business and design, with its main Riccarton campus near Edinburgh and international campuses in Dubai and Malaysia. It is known for actuarial science, petroleum engineering, brewing and distilling, and textiles and fashion at its Scottish Borders campus.

Apply through UCAS. Entry requirements are moderate (MA Economics: BBC at A-level or IB 29), and international fees are lower than at many UK universities.

summary.en: A Welsh university with two seaside campuses, ranked 292nd in the world by QS 2026. It offers moderate entry requirements and fees, plus foundation, year-abroad and industry-year routes.

about.en:
Swansea University in Wales has two campuses by the sea: Singleton Park and the Bay Campus, home to its engineering and management schools. It is strong in engineering, computer science, health and law, and many degrees offer a foundation year, a year abroad or a year in industry.

about.en:
Oxford Brookes University is a separate, modern university in Oxford with its main Headington campus on the east of the city. It is known for architecture, hospitality and tourism, business, motorsport engineering, nursing and the health professions, with strong employer links and optional placement years.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks ABB or IB 32 (contextual BCC / 29), with international fees of £20,800 a year and £2,000 international scholarships available.

about.en:
Brunel University of London has a single campus in Uxbridge, west London, close to Heathrow and on the Underground. It is known for engineering and design, computer science, sport sciences, economics and law, and many degrees include an optional placement year.

Apply through UCAS. Economics typically asks ABB at A-level or IB 31, with IELTS 6.5 (5.5 per area). At £19,895 a year for 2027/28, it is one of the more affordable London options for international students.

about.en:
Bilkent University, founded in 1984, is an English-medium private university on a self-contained campus in Ankara. It is known for engineering, economics, sciences, and music and performing arts, and a large share of its students study on scholarships.

International students apply online in a long spring–summer window and are assessed on school grades and exam scores (for example SAT 1000+). Merit scholarships waive 20% to 100% of tuition, which was US$18,400 a year for 2026 entrants.
